The Quiz Club of St. Dominic's College, Kanjirapally, proudly presents
QuizDom2026,theDominicanIntercollegiateQuizContestforthe
ever-rolling trophy instituted in memory of Mar Joseph Powathil, the
first Bishop of the Eparchy ofKanjirapally.This annual intellectual
celebrationbegan in2024.University College,Thiruvananthapuram,
and B.Ed.College,Alappuzha,jointly won the firstprize and the
ever-rolling trophy in Season Il in 2025. The event is enriched by the
generous support of the Alumni of St. Dominic's College, who sponsor
the prizes, making this contest a vibrant tradition that unites
knowledge, memory, and legacy.
